desc: A high-quality firearm designed for both performance and elegance. With a 3-inch chamber, it features a blued barrel and a checkered stock, offering both durability and aesthetic appeal. The shotgun is equipped with a single-selective mechanical reset trigger system and a manual safety. It comes with five Beretta/Benelli Mobil chokes (C, IC, M, IM, F) and a fiber optic front sight for enhanced accuracy. The Charles Daly logo is engraved on the receiver, adding a touch of distinction to this classic over/under shotgun.
